raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Since the 2026-01-16 rollout, the v2 collector emits txn_ts in UTC, while legacy rows (the historical convention) are in America/Chicago local time. The pipeline casts both the same way, so v2 evening transactions move into the next day's early hours. That explains the 00:00-06:00 cluster on 2026-01-18 and the spurious 41-row 2026-01-19 partition. Converting v2 timestamps to Chicago time (CST, UTC-6 for this all-January window) fixes txn_ts and txn_date.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
